sharedPrompt:

A rear view shows the indigo outer covers and spine, not a face pasted on the back. Keep cap and bookmark physically consistent with rotation. Each composition is deliberately different from the reference's upright, front-facing smiling mascot. Follow the specified camera, action, scale and expression closely; do not default to a front-facing central portrait.

badges.name: Primeiras cartas
badges.story: O Folha embaralha um pequeno maço enquanto as cartas se abrem em leque.
badges.pose: Vista zenital; livro em diagonal no canto superior esquerdo, mãos embaralhando abaixo dele.
badges.direction: A genuine TOP-DOWN bird's-eye view of a warm study desk. Folha floats flat ABOVE the desk in the UPPER LEFT quadrant, its open page-face tilted diagonally 45 degrees and seen from directly overhead, not upright. Its two arms curve down toward the foreground; each hand holds one half of a small deck mid-shuffle, with separate cream study cards flying in a graceful fan across the lower-right of the circular scene. Mischievous concentrated half-smile, one eyebrow raised, eyes following the cards rather than the viewer. Small mint pictograms on cards, no writing. The tabletop grain and scattered cards reinforce the overhead camera.

badges.name: Baralho afiado
badges.story: Um castelo de cartas de estudo recebe sua última carta, equilibrada com cuidado.
badges.pose: Personagem pequeno, de perfil em três quartos por trás, alcançando o topo à direita.
badges.direction: A towering delicate HOUSE OF STUDY CARDS dominates the interior from foreground to high center. Folha is SMALL near the UPPER RIGHT, floating, seen in REAR THREE-QUARTER PROFILE almost edge-on: indigo back cover and a thin sliver of cream cheek visible, eyes focused downward. One arm stretches LEFTWARD above the head to balance the LAST card at the castle's apex using fingertips; the other arm extends behind as a counterbalance. Tense, careful expression, tiny pursed mouth. Low camera looking UP along the towering card structure. No ladder, no standing, no legs. The triangular cards and distant library shelves create deep scale. Blank cards with tiny mint geometric pictograms only.

badges.name: Mestre das cartas
badges.story: As cartas giram como uma galáxia em volta do Folha, que flutua de cabeça para baixo.
badges.pose: Livro completamente invertido, braços abertos seguindo a espiral.
badges.direction: A magnificent GALAXY made of individual cream study cards spirals through a dark indigo star-filled library-cosmos. Folha FLOATS COMPLETELY UPSIDE DOWN, cap BELOW its face and lower book edge ABOVE, rotated about 165 degrees, off-center to the RIGHT of the vortex. The open book is foreshortened as if tumbling in zero gravity; both arms sweep in different curved directions to guide the card spiral, not holding a trophy or pen. Delighted playful closed-mouth grin and sparkling eyes looking along the flow. Mint bookmark and tassel drift naturally upward relative to the inverted book. Warm amber light glints on cards; distinct front and rear spiral layers create depth. No feet or body beneath this book, no text on cards.

badges.name: Primeiros grifos
badges.story: De perfil e com a língua de fora, o Folha destaca uma linha amarela no caderno.
badges.pose: Perfil lateral estrito, rosto comprimido pela perspectiva e língua de fora.
badges.direction: STRICT SIDE PROFILE, camera at tabletop level. Folha occupies the LEFT of the interior, nearly edge-on: its indigo spine, fanned cream page thickness and ONE visible eye dominate the silhouette; do NOT turn the full two-eye face toward the viewer. He leans far forward over a notebook toward the RIGHT, tip of tongue sticking out in comic concentration. One hand grips a chunky YELLOW highlighter making one luminous yellow horizontal stroke on the cream notebook, the other hand pins the page flat. His cap projects back, mint bookmark hangs beside spine. Very intimate desk-level scene with clear textured ink/gouache. Notebook has abstract thin lines and yellow highlight blocks, absolutely no letters, words or numbers. No legs, no feet.

badges.name: Caderno vivo
badges.story: Um caderno cheio de grifos e post-its vira um esconderijo para o Folha curioso.
badges.pose: Rosto bem próximo, espiando por uma abertura entre páginas e post-its.
badges.direction: An extreme foreground NOTEBOOK fills most of the scene, its curling pages covered in tactile YELLOW, MINT GREEN and PINK highlight bands with layered blank sticky notes emerging on all sides. Through a small opening between two lifted pages in the UPPER RIGHT, Folha PEEKS inquisitively: only the upper half of his cream book-face, one larger eye and one partly obscured eye, graduation cap and mint bookmark are visible; most of his indigo book body is hidden BEHIND the pages. One hand lifts the curling page like a curtain; the other points to a vivid highlighted patch below. Wide-eyed curious delighted expression, NOT the usual full mascot portrait. The pages create a strong close-up framing-within-the-frame. No text or pseudo-handwriting.

badges.name: Biblioteca própria

badges.pose: Bem pequeno ao fundo, de costas em três quartos, mãos elevadas guardando um caderno.
badges.direction: A long personal NOTEBOOK LIBRARY viewed from deep inside a shelf, oversized textured notebook spines in the LEFT and RIGHT foreground framing a long warm amber aisle. Folha appears VERY SMALL FAR IN THE BACK, upper center, floating near a high shelf, seen from REAR THREE-QUARTER VIEW. Proud, satisfied posture conveyed by upward tilt; only a tiny partial smiling cheek may be visible in side sliver. The main visual is deep perspective, not a large central face. Notebooks have colored tabs/highlight colors but absolutely no spine lettering or numbers. No ladder, no lower limbs.

badges.name: Zona de foco

badges.pose: Reclinado de lado, em posição horizontal, uma mão sustentando o rosto e a outra lendo.
badges.direction: A luminous translucent MINT SILENCE BUBBLE fills the central circular scene. badges.name: Monge do estudo
badges.story: O Folha medita suspenso sobre uma pilha de livros ao entardecer.
badges.pose: Câmera muito baixa; livro flutuando alto, páginas inclinadas para baixo e mãos em meditação.
badges.direction: Dramatic VERY LOW CAMERA looking UP from beside a tall pile of books. Folha levitates HIGH in the UPPER LEFT of the inner circle over the book stack, open book tilted toward the horizon, foreshortened so its lower cover edge and cream page thickness are prominent. The face bows DOWN, eyes peacefully closed, gentle solemn expression. Both arms extend outward from the side edges with relaxed hands making a simple thumb-and-finger meditation gesture. Its book body floats alone, ABSOLUTELY NO human torso, legs, lotus-position knees or feet. A warm SUNSET over distant library windows and soft clouds glows behind, mint bookmark floating upward. Book stack and long sunset shadows dominate the lower foreground. Keep Folha smaller than the pile, not a centered frontal portrait.

badges.name: Errou, aprendeu
badges.story: Nas mãos do Folha, um erro vermelho se transforma num acerto verde.
badges.pose: Macro das mãos; só parte do rosto aparece na borda esquerda.
badges.direction: A tight MACRO action view INSIDE the medal: Folha's TWO HANDS are large in the immediate foreground, cupped around a RED CROSS mark transforming through tiny colored sparks into a GREEN CHECKMARK. These are grading PICTOGRAMS, not a typed letter X or written character. The transformation is the visual focus. Folha's cream book-face enters only PARTLY from the FAR LEFT, cropped by the INTERNAL circular opening: one relieved eye, lifted brow, small open sighing smile, partial indigo cover, cap corner and mint bookmark. Face turned toward its hands, not toward viewer; never show a whole central front-facing book. A corrected paper with abstract blocks lies beneath. Warm desk light, clear readable red-to-green transition, no numbers or text.

badges.name: Virada de jogo
badges.story: De costas, o Folha rasga a prova com erros e revela uma nova folha cheia de acertos.
badges.pose: Costas diretamente para a câmera, braços abertos rasgando a folha.
badges.direction: DIRECT REAR VIEW at medium distance: Folha floats in the LOWER CENTER with its INDIGO OUTER BOOK COVERS and central spine facing the camera, open covers like a shallow V. Graduation cap above, mint bookmark hangs down from the top edge. NO eyes or mouth on the rear cover. Both arms spread WIDE to the left and right, each pulling one half of a cream exam sheet apart. The split halves display red grading CROSS pictograms; the opening reveals behind a luminous intact cream sheet covered in green CHECK pictograms. No typed letters, numbers, questions or text. The energetic stretched arms and determined forward tilt convey a triumphant change. Paper fibers and torn edges are exquisitely painted. Do NOT rotate the mascot back to face the viewer; the clear back-view is mandatory.

badges.name: Erro não se repete
badges.story: O Folha gira a chave do cofre que guarda os erros já superados.
badges.pose: Câmera baixa em três quartos do lado da lombada, corpo inclinado contra o cofre.
badges.direction: A substantial ornate GOLD SAFE fills the RIGHT two-thirds of the interior, door just closing on cream papers with small red grading cross pictograms. A giant key projects toward the lower-left foreground. Folha floats on the LEFT, viewed in LOW THREE-QUARTER SPINE-FIRST perspective: the indigo binding is closest to camera and the cream face recedes sharply toward the safe. Its book body leans about 60 degrees toward the door, visibly bracing the action; one hand turns the large key clockwise, the other palm presses on the safe's rim. Proud squinting smile, brow lifted, eyes aimed toward the key. Frame remains face-on, inner scene strongly foreshortened. No lower limbs, no shoes, no written safe labels or key numbers.

badges.name: Salvo pelo Folha
badges.requirement: Ter a sequência salva pelo Marca-página do Folha
badges.story: Com um dedo na boca, o Folha protege o sono de uma pequena fênix sobre a chama azul.
badges.pose: Close lateral inclinado, indicador na boca e a outra mão protegendo a fênix.
badges.direction: Intimate secretive CLOSE SIDE-THREE-QUARTER scene. Folha's face tilts DOWN and INWARD from the UPPER LEFT, very close to a TINY sleeping phoenix curled on a bronze brazier in the LOWER RIGHT. One clearly articulated index finger is held vertically to its own lips in a SHUSH gesture; the other hand forms a gentle shielding arch beside the small bird without touching fire. One eye is softly narrowed, the other looks at the sleeping phoenix, a conspiratorial caring expression rather than a big smile. Indigo cap partly behind the tilted book; mint bookmark drapes toward the phoenix. The phoenix's eyes are CLOSED, wings tucked, peaceful; a small magical BLUE flame glows beneath it, contrasting with rich amber surroundings. Preserve the GOLD laurel/cap frame, no fiery frame redesign. No writing or letters.

badges.name: Madrugador
badges.story: Ao nascer do sol, o Folha boceja abraçado à xícara de café nas duas mãos.
badges.pose: Abraçado à xícara, livro curvado para a frente; câmera alta em três quartos.
badges.direction: At SUNRISE beside a large east-facing window, viewed from a HIGH RIGHT THREE-QUARTER angle. A big warm COFFEE CUP occupies the central foreground. Folha's book body folds gently FORWARD AROUND the cup like a sleepy hug, almost closing around its warmth: indigo back cover edges clearly visible on either side, cream face bent over the steam, graduation cap drooping askew. BOTH hands wrap around the sides of the same cup, close together, no other hand action. Mouth wide in a genuine YAWN, heavy eyelids and lifted sleepy brows; this is tender and drowsy, NOT a cheerful upright smile. A pink-peach sun clears the horizon outside, golden steam curls in cool morning light. Cup rests on desk, book floats at cup level with no lower appendages. No clock digits or letters.

badges.pose: De bruços quase na horizontal, queixo apoiado nas mãos e olhos voltados para a coruja.
badges.direction: A nocturnal overhead-oblique view of a desk by a STAR-FILLED night window. Folha lies PRONE almost flat across the desk, open book-face lifted only at its TOP EDGE, body receding diagonally AWAY from camera; its chin rests on BOTH HANDS, elbows planted close together on a separate open study notebook. Its eyes look UP sideways toward a SMALL OWL perched on the tilted graduation cap; a wry tired-but-amused small smile, one eyebrow raised. The owl's claws grip only the cap brim and it looks attentively back; bird legs are natural, Folha has NONE. A curved TABLE LAMP on the right creates a focused pool of warm light on the cream notebook, deep midnight indigo and stars beyond. Show the distinct prone, chin-in-hands pose, NOT a front-facing upright book, not a reclined cheek-on-one-hand pose. No text, no clock digits.
badges.prompt:
Create ONE new Estudário Collection III achievement emblem, a professional hand-painted storybook illustration. Reference image 1 (Collection II plano-200) establishes the character, ink/gouache/colored-pencil texture, high craftsmanship, frame silhouette, thickness, relative scale, and square framing. It is a STYLE/FRAME reference, NOT a pose or scene to copy. When reference 2 is present it establishes only the requested Bronze or Silver material. Copy the approved outer medal geometry: circular opening, symmetrical laurel branches, indigo graduation-cap crest at top, ornamental scrollwork, lower diamond, wide draped INDIGO FABRIC ribbon with matching metal piping, mint insets where present. Preserve the same outer silhouette and amount of padding as the references; the full crest, laurel and ribbon tails fit inside the square. Keep the frame face-on even if the INNER scene uses a dramatic camera angle. Do not replace the frame with a new badge shape. Material must match the tier instruction. The interior is a complete richly painted narrative vignette confined inside the opening, with meaningful depth, lighting, tactile paper and ink linework. No flat vector art, photorealism, plastic 3D, generic stock icon, oversmoothing or artificial blur.
FOLHA is the SAME anthropomorphic BOOK: cream pages form its face, indigo cover/binding, indigo graduation cap, mint bookmark, expressive eyes and mouth, TWO arms and hands attached to its sides. Absolutely NO human torso, NO LEGS, NO FEET, NO SHOES, NO SOCKS, NO lower-body supports, NO knees or crossed legs. The lower contour ends in the BOOK COVER. Movement is FLOATING. A rear view shows the indigo outer covers and spine, not a face pasted on the back. Keep cap and bookmark physically consistent with rotation. Each composition is deliberately different from the reference's upright, front-facing smiling mascot. Follow the specified camera, action, scale and expression closely; do not default to a front-facing central portrait.
No text, no letters, no numerals, no pseudo-writing, no watermark anywhere, including papers and props. Blank study papers may have colored highlight strokes, simple pictograms or checkmarks, never words. The large indigo ribbon remains completely EMPTY; decorative stitching is allowed. Outside the entire medal silhouette use genuine alpha TRANSPARENCY, not a solid background or drawn checkerboard. Square original at the reference's high detail, no cropping. Produce the single complete emblem only, no contact sheet.

SILVER tier: engraved cool polished silver, cold pale reflections and silver ribbon piping, mint insets. Avoid warm copper and gold in the outer frame. Match Collection II Silver reference.

The owl's claws grip only the cap brim and it looks attentively back; bird legs are natural, Folha has NONE. A curved TABLE LAMP on the right creates a focused pool of warm light on the cream notebook, deep midnight indigo and stars beyond. Show the distinct prone, chin-in-hands pose, NOT a front-facing upright book, not a reclined cheek-on-one-hand pose. No text, no clock digits.
